label: Microsoft Fabric
headline: Microsoft Fabric Cheat Sheet
description: Quick reference for Microsoft Fabric — from OneLake and Data Factory to Lakehouses, Warehouses, Real-Time Analytics, Power BI integration, and governance.

items.name: Microsoft Fabric
items.definition: An end-to-end analytics SaaS platform that unifies data engineering, data integration, data warehousing, data science, real-time analytics, and business intelligence in a single environment.

items.name: OneLake
items.definition: Fabric’s central storage layer. OneLake stores all organizational data in open formats and provides a single source of truth across Fabric workloads.

items.name: Lakehouse
items.definition: Combines data lake flexibility with warehouse-style structure. Stores files and Delta tables for analytics, notebooks, SQL queries, and Power BI reporting.

items.name: Warehouse
items.definition: A fully managed SQL-based analytics warehouse optimized for structured relational querying and reporting workloads.

items.name: Data Factory
items.definition: Fabric’s data integration layer for creating pipelines, orchestrating data movement, and scheduling transformations across multiple systems.

items.name: Real-Time Analytics
items.definition: Handles streaming and high-frequency telemetry data using Kusto Query Language (KQL) for fast querying and monitoring.

items.name: Power BI
items.definition: Provides visualization, semantic modeling, dashboards, and enterprise reporting capabilities directly within Fabric workspaces.

items.name: Workspace
items.definition: Logical container for organizing Fabric assets such as Lakehouses, Warehouses, Pipelines, Reports, and Notebooks.

items.name: Capacity
items.definition: Dedicated compute resources assigned to Fabric workloads. Determines performance, concurrency, and feature availability.

items.name: Shortcuts
items.definition: Creates virtual references to external storage locations without copying the data into OneLake.

items.name: Delta Tables
items.definition: Transactional storage format supporting ACID compliance, schema evolution, and scalable analytics.

items.name: Files Section
items.definition: Stores raw and semi-structured files such as CSV, JSON, Parquet, and text files before transformation.

items.name: Tables Section
items.definition: Contains structured Delta tables optimized for SQL analytics and Power BI consumption.

items.name: Notebook
items.definition: Interactive Spark-based environment supporting Python, SQL, Scala, and Spark operations for large-scale data engineering.

items.name: Apache Spark
items.definition: Distributed processing engine used for large-scale transformations, machine learning, and notebook execution.

items.name: PySpark
items.definition: Allows scalable distributed data processing using Python syntax within Fabric notebooks.

items.name: DataFrame
items.definition: Distributed tabular data structure used in Spark for transformations, filtering, aggregation, and joins.

items.name: Save as Table
items.definition: Writes Spark DataFrame results directly into a managed Lakehouse Delta table.

items.name: Semantic Link
items.definition: Enables notebooks and machine learning workloads to directly interact with Power BI semantic models.

items.name: Pipeline
items.definition: Workflow orchestration engine used to automate ingestion, transformation, and movement of data.

items.name: Copy Activity
items.definition: Moves data from source systems into Fabric destinations such as Lakehouses and Warehouses.

items.name: Dataflow Gen2
items.definition: Modern Power Query-based ETL tool inside Fabric that supports scalable cloud-native transformations.

items.name: Schedule Pipeline
items.definition: Configures recurring execution of data workflows at specified intervals.

items.name: Parameters
items.definition: Dynamic values passed into pipeline activities for reusable and configurable workflows.

items.name: Monitor Hub
items.definition: Centralized interface for viewing execution history, failures, durations, and refresh status across Fabric workloads.

items.name: SQL Endpoint
items.definition: Automatically generated SQL interface that enables T-SQL querying against Lakehouse tables.

items.name: T-SQL
items.definition: Primary SQL dialect used in Fabric Warehouses and SQL Endpoints for querying and transformations.

items.name: Stored Procedure
items.definition: Reusable SQL routines that encapsulate logic and automate database operations.

items.name: View
items.definition: Virtual table defined by a SQL query to simplify reporting and abstract complexity.

items.name: CTAS
items.definition: Creates a new table from the output of a SQL query. Common for staging and transformations.

items.name: Star Schema
items.definition: Recommended modeling pattern for analytics workloads. Optimizes performance and simplifies reporting.

items.name: Eventstream
items.definition: Captures and routes streaming data from sources such as IoT devices, applications, and logs.

items.name: KQL Database
items.definition: High-performance analytics engine optimized for log analytics, telemetry, and time-series workloads.

items.name: Kusto Query Language (KQL)
items.definition: Read-optimized query language designed for fast filtering, aggregation, and analytics on streaming data.

items.name: Real-Time Dashboard
items.definition: Interactive dashboard for monitoring live streaming data and operational metrics.

items.name: Streaming Data
items.definition: Data arriving continuously in near real time from devices, APIs, sensors, or applications.

items.name: Semantic Model
items.definition: Business-friendly data model used for Power BI reporting, DAX calculations, and reusable analytics.

items.name: Direct Lake
items.definition: High-performance mode allowing Power BI to query Delta tables directly from OneLake without import refreshes.

items.name: Import Mode
items.definition: Loads data into memory for fast query performance. Requires scheduled refresh to stay current.

items.name: DAX
items.definition: Expression language used for calculations and analytics in Power BI semantic models.

items.name: Report
items.definition: Interactive analytical canvas containing charts, filters, KPIs, and drill-through capabilities.

items.name: Dashboard
items.definition: High-level monitoring interface created from pinned report visuals and KPIs.

items.name: Microsoft Purview
items.definition: Provides data cataloging, lineage, sensitivity labels, and governance across Fabric assets.

items.name: Row-Level Security (RLS)
items.definition: Restricts access to specific rows of data based on the logged-in user.

items.name: Sensitivity Labels
items.definition: Classifies and protects sensitive organizational data across Fabric and Microsoft 365.

items.name: Data Lineage
items.definition: Tracks upstream and downstream dependencies between datasets, reports, pipelines, and tables.

items.name: Workspace Roles
items.definition: Controls permissions and collaboration capabilities within Fabric workspaces.

items.name: Use Medallion Architecture
items.definition: Layer raw, cleaned, and business-ready data into separate stages for maintainability and governance.

items.name: Optimize Delta Tables
items.definition: Maintain Delta table performance by compacting files and cleaning obsolete data.

items.name: Separate Storage & Compute
items.definition: Use OneLake for centralized storage while scaling compute independently using Fabric capacities.

items.name: Prefer Direct Lake
items.definition: Reduces refresh overhead and improves report performance by querying OneLake directly.

items.name: Implement Naming Standards
items.definition: Use structured naming conventions for workspaces, tables, pipelines, and reports to improve governance.
